verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python framework you install and run in your own code/infrastructure — docs emphasize it runs 'everywhere you need it: behind a web frontend, in the terminal, on a voice call, on a durable background queue, or as a plain object you call run() on,' which inherently means self-hosting the core agent logic, and community reports confirm running it in production/self-managed environments. missing for 10: explicit open-source license statement, dedicated self-hosting/deployment guide, and confirmation that adjacent services (Logfire, AI Gateway) are optional rather than required.
